a: Blue-green deploys switch traffic between two environments.
Canaries expose a small percentage of users to a new version.
Feature toggles separate deploy from release.
Runbooks document steps to handle common incidents.
Blameless postmortems focus on system fixes, not blame.
On-call engineers respond to alerts outside normal hours.
Capacity planning estimates resources needed for growth.
Track cloud spend by service and team to control costs.
Drift is when live infra differs from declared IaC.
Immutable infrastructure replaces servers instead of mutating them.
